description: AppWorld ECHO rules, as in the paper (arXiv:2605.24517, Section 3.2: env_only): leave out tool-response text that appworld_react/episode.py writes itself, not the AppWorld environment. The interaction-budget message and a failed /execute dispatch are JSON objects that start with {"error": (AppWorld's own failures arrive as 'Execution failed. Traceback: ...'); outputs over 60000 characters end with the harness's '[truncated]' line. API documentation outputs are kept, as the paper keeps every terminal output.
